conviction_note: Six small, offsetting findings: freight inflation in May-July 2026 (diesel up about 84c YoY in early July and $5.31 by 27 July) against healthy cat-litter category demand, record renewable-diesel output, flat-to-lower natural gas and a newly enlarged credit and acquisition capacity. Nothing decides the print. abs_move_pct comes from the name's own 7-print median of 7.72% (there is no option chain, the stock has 2 or fewer analysts and FY27 commentary is likely) and is nudged to 8.0. p_up is 52 because 5 of 7 prior prints rose and the stock went in 6.6% lower over 5 sessions with no company news. The finding sum of +0.1 and the scaled +0.32 agree, and both are near zero.
bar: No sell-side consensus could be sourced: TipRanks shows an empty consensus field from 0 analysts (https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/ODC/earnings), and the sweep reports 2 estimates. The effective bar is the company's own statement in the Q3 release (2026-06-08, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000074046/000162828026041544/odcf26q3ex991-earningsrele.htm): 'we expect to achieve our annual plan and surpass last year's net income'. FY25 net income was $54.0M (https://finviz.com/news/188665/oil-dri-delivers-strongest-annual-financial-results-in-history-bolstered-by-solid-fourth-quarter-performance) and 9M FY26 net income was $42.6M, so the company's floor is Q4 NI > $11.4M. Prior-year Q4 was net sales $125.2M, NI $13.0M and diluted EPS $0.89. print_vs_bar_pct is measured on Q4 revenue against the prior-year $125.2M: R&W should grow (Q3 +13%) while B2B laps a +24% Q4 FY25 comp. Because the bar is unsourced, every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: There is no option chain (baseline options.status no_options_market), so there is no skew. Short interest is about 376k shares, 2.6% of float, 3.8 days to cover, as of 2026-08-20 (https://equibles.com/stocks/odc/short-interest). FINRA's 2026-07-15 settlement shows about 404.7k shares and about 3.4 days (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/odc/short-interest/). That is not a crowded short. Tape: run_up_5d -6.56%, run_up_20d -0.92%, 19.8% below the 52-week high (about $104.9 in July 2026 per MarketBeat) and +84.8% above the 52-week low. A GuruFocus headline reports a -4.3% day on 2026-09-25 with no stated cause. 20-day average volume is about 121k shares, so turnover is thin.

findings.finding: US on-highway diesel, which drives Oil-Dri's outbound freight on heavy, low-value litter and absorbents, rose through fiscal Q4 (May-July 2026). EIA readings were $4.668 on Jun 29, $4.578 on Jul 6 (84c above a year earlier), $4.796 on Jul 13, $5.134 on Jul 20 and $5.31 on Jul 27. Q4 FY25 ran near $3.6-3.8. In Q3 domestic COGS per ton was already +6% and gross margin fell 190bp to 26.7%; the prior-year Q4 margin was 27.8%. Q4 gross margin below about 26.5% would mark a further step down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 showed a 190bp gross-margin decline but +9% sales and +25% NI; the stock rose +17.38%, so margin pressure was looked through when sales and NI beat. Dec 2025 fell -12.55% (Q1 FY26, H1 described as 'challenging comparisons'); the driver of that drop was not established.
findings.why_not_priced: Management named transportation and input-cost headwinds on 2026-06-08 and 2026-06-09 ('We are continuing to see increases in freight costs'), but the July leg of the spike, roughly +$0.75/gal inside the quarter, came after the call. With 0-2 analysts there is no published model updating Q4 margin for it. Had it been priced, the stock would have de-rated on the diesel move in July-August. Instead it drifted from about $98 at the start of August to about $92 by late August, and the 5-day -6.6% came in October.
findings.independence: The same series is reported by Work Truck ($5.31 on Jul 27, https://www.worktruckonline.com/news/july-diesel-trends-update-v2). Company confirmation of freight pressure comes from the Q3 call (https://allmind.ai/earnings/event/2916921). Both are a macro proxy, not a company-level number.

findings.finding: Arm & Hammer cat litter was named a driver of Church & Dwight's Q2 2026 organic growth: Consumer Domestic organic sales +5.1% with +3.6% volume, for the April-June quarter that overlaps Oil-Dri's fiscal Q4. Clorox's Household segment, which includes Fresh Step litter, fell 18% in its June quarter (16 points of volume, partly lapping ERP shipments), and Fresh Step is described as in a turnaround. Together these point to firm category demand and share moving away from Clorox, which favours private-label and value suppliers. Oil-Dri's management said on 2026-06-09 that it expects 'additional shifting to private label'. Its R&W segment was a record $82.5M in Q3 (+13%), and co-packaged litter was +94%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26: R&W +13% on cat litter, and the stock rose +17.38% (baseline; Zacks recap 'record sales drive the stock'). Q4 FY25: R&W +3% and total sales +10%, and the stock rose +8.23%.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer prints from July 31 and August 3 landed after Oil-Dri last spoke on June 8-9, and no analyst on Oil-Dri publicly bridged them. Had they been priced, the stock would not have drifted about 19% off its July high into the print. Note that part of Q3's litter gain was a storm-delayed order shift that does not recur in Q4.
findings.independence: The Clorox Q4 FY26 release, 2026-08-03 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000021076/000002107626000028/ex991-pressreleasedatedaug.htm), is a different company and a different document. Oil-Dri's own Q3 call comment on the private-label shift is at https://allmind.ai/earnings/event/2916921. Both peers are proxies.

findings.finding: US renewable diesel output hit a record in June 2026: 327 million gallons per EPA data cited by Clean Fuels, and a record per EIA via Quantum. EIA raised its 2026 RD production forecast to 241k b/d in the August STEO. This supports Oil-Dri's fluids-purification (bleaching clay) line, which was down about 1% in Q3. Oil-Dri's fluids-purification VP said on the call that refinery margins were 'running real high', with a stable market for 12-18 months. Netted against B2B lapping a +24% Q4 FY25 ($48.1M), B2B is probably flat to down year on year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: B2B drove FY25 (+21% sales, +31% operating income) and Q4 FY25 (+24%), when the stock rose +8.23%. In Q3 FY26 B2B was +3% with operating income -3%, while R&W carried the +17% reaction.
findings.source_date: 2026-08 (June data; date from page context, not URL)
findings.why_not_priced: This is an industry series that no Oil-Dri preview ties to the fluids line. The stock's 2026 weakness does not look like a priced RD recovery. The B2B comp makes the year-on-year optics hard, which limits the size.
findings.independence: Argus reports the EIA August STEO raise (https://www.argusmedia.com/en/news-and-insights/latest-market-news/2863954-eia-raises-renewable-diesel-output-view). Company commentary is at https://allmind.ai/earnings/event/2916921. All of it is proxy.

findings.finding: 8-K accepted 2026-10-07 20:02, the evening before the print. Oil-Dri amended its BMO credit agreement: revolver $75M -> $100M, maturity extended to 2031-10-07, pricing reduced, accordion raised to the greater of $125M or 100% of consolidated EBITDA, and the $100M cumulative permitted-acquisitions limit removed. It also doubled its Prudential private shelf from $75M to $150M (window to 2029). A new restricted-payments covenant governs dividends and buybacks. The company had $62.9M cash and $39.8M debt at 2026-04-30, so this is acquisition capacity, not a liquidity need.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The prior acquisition, Ultra Pet ($46M, 2024), added about 3% to FY25 sales, but no clean reaction to it on a print is recorded. No earlier financing 8-K reaction is available.
findings.why_not_priced: It was filed after the close on Oct 7, and no wire story about it was found. Its read-through (lifting the acquisition cap and adding up to about $200M+ of capacity) has not been explained by the company. If the call or release names a deal or an M&A pipeline, this is the item behind it. On what the money buys: there is no corroborated use; it is not distress (net cash about $23M, record sales); it is a positive or a zero.
findings.independence: none (single document; no acquisition news found in searches)

findings.finding: Q3 SG&A fell $2.5M (13%) to $16.6M 'primarily [from] a lower corporate bonus accrual', and 9M SG&A was $51.8M against $55.7M. Yet the CEO said FY26 would achieve plan and beat FY25 NI. If plan is achieved, the incentive accrual may normalise or catch up in Q4, so a Q4 NI at or above last year's $13.0M has a higher SG&A hurdle than Q3's $14.5M suggests.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3's NI beat (+25%) was flattered by this bonus line, and the stock rose +17.38%. No prior instance of a Q4 true-up reaction is recorded.
findings.why_not_priced: Headline recaps (Zacks, 'Q3 earnings jump 25%') carried the NI figure and not its bonus-accrual source. If priced, Q3's +17% would have been read as partly non-recurring. This is an inference from a primary document, not a disclosed Q4 number.
findings.independence: none (same document as the bar; the inference is mine)

findings.finding: Henry Hub spot (kiln fuel for clay drying) averaged about $3.15/MMBtu in June 2026 and about $2.89 in July 2026, falling to $2.59 by Jul 31 per Argus. That is roughly flat-to-lower year on year and below EIA's $3.37 Q3 forecast, so energy input cost is not a fresh headwind beyond freight.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Gross margin moved with cost per ton: FY25 margin +90bp, and the stock rose; Q3 FY26 -190bp, yet the stock rose +17%. Energy has not been isolated as a reaction driver.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a small offset that nobody bridges to Oil-Dri, and the company's hedging is not disclosed in the sources read. It is a proxy only.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The findings are near zero net and slightly lean against the recent 5-day weakness, which is unexplained by anything found.
lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the credit and acquisition capacity finding has no corroborated use (no deal named), so it was cut from +0.5 to +0.3 and kept positive because it is not distress

Lessons 5 and 6 (proxy evidence; unsourced bar caps sizes): the peer-litter finding was cut from +0.7 to +0.5. It rests on two peers, one of which (Clorox) is lapping ERP shipments, and the bar is only the company's qualitative statement

Left standing: the diesel, renewable-diesel, bonus-accrual and natural-gas findings were already small, proxy-sized and inside the window; abs_move_pct was kept at 8.0 per lesson 8 (thin coverage, no option chain)
